title: feat(spec)!: an install through POST /api/v1/packages declares manifest.scope project only, so an authored install cannot lock itself
body:
Fixes #24062

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

An install through `POST /api/v1/packages` may now declare `manifest.scope` `project` only, or leave it out. `cloud` and `system` are refused at parse time with `400` / `VALIDATION_ERROR`, on both body forms and on either overwrite spelling, and the refusal says what to write instead. So an authored install can no longer lock itself. `ManifestSchema` is unchanged for every other producer.

Session: `session_015p3xNTnaiNHYkAHoQ4y5Cg` (the `os-dev` cloud run dispatched by the `domain:spec#2` seat, claim `6230547268`). Base `9f024d8a2c`, head `b78d15a5`.

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/api/package-api.zod.ts`
  - New export `PackageInstallManifestSchema` (plus the types `PackageInstallManifest` and `PackageInstallManifestParsed`). It is `ManifestSchema.extend({ scope })` with `scope: z.enum(['project'], { error }).default('project')`. Every other key, the strict close, its unknown-key prescription and the retired-key tombstones ride the `.extend()` unchanged; the authorable-surface shard lists the same key set, tombstones included.
  - New export `packageInstallScopeRefusal(input)`: the one refusal sentence. It names the value sent, why `cloud` / `system` lock the package, and the remedy: "Remove `scope` (it defaults to `project`), or write `scope: 'project'`."
  - `PackageInstallRequestSchema.manifest` and the bare branch of `PackageInstallBodySchema` both now use `PackageInstallManifestSchema`. The docblocks that named `ManifestSchema` for those two positions now name the new schema.
  - The `overwrite` describe gains: "an id the deployment ships read-only (code-booted, or scope cloud / system) is refused 422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED". I re-read PR #24055's door on `main`: `requireWritablePackage` runs after the 409, for both overwrite spellings, at `packages.ts` (the `readOnly` leg).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`: **one line plus its comment and import, a deviation from the dispatch's "no runtime source change" expectation, measured and reported below.** `installBodyRefusal` re-parses the bare form through `PackageInstallManifestSchema`, the union's own bare branch, instead of `ManifestSchema`.
- Tests: spec pins in `package-api.test.ts`, and the door pins as §9 of `packages-install-body-contract.test.ts`.
- Generated outputs, regenerated by the generators only: the `api` shards of `api-surface`, `authorable-surface`, `authorable-defaults`, `json-schema.manifest`, `declaration-map` and `export-origins`; `content/docs/references/api/package-api.mdx` and `references/index.mdx`. Plus one hand-edited ledger, `dropped-refinements.baseline.json`: the build printed the entry for the new published schema `api/PackageInstallManifest` (the same `navigationContributions` site `api/PackageInstallRequest` already declares), and the header totals 235 to 236 and 766 to 767, which `scripts/dropped-refinements.test.ts` asserts. Delta vs `main`: 3 exports added, 0 removed.
- `.changeset/24062-authored-install-scope-project.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor` (BREAKING narrowing, launch-window convention, PR #24055's `62f959dd62` precedent) and `@objectstack/runtime` `patch`. It carries FROM / TO, the `Clause-②` line, and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. The only conversion that could exist (rewrite `cloud` / `system` to `project`) is the silent rewrite this card refuses.

## Accept set, before and after

| Body | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| wrapped `{ manifest }`, `scope: 'cloud'` or `'system'` | `201`, authored row stored with that scope | `400` `VALIDATION_ERROR`, nothing installed; issue `invalid_value` at `manifest.scope` |
| bare manifest, `scope: 'cloud'` or `'system'` | `201` | `400` `VALIDATION_ERROR`, nothing installed; issue at `scope` |
| either form with `overwrite: true` or `?overwrite=true`, platform scope | `201` on a fresh id; over an authored project row it re-locked that row | `400`, ahead of the 409 and the read-only gate; an existing row keeps its manifest |
| `scope: 'project'`, either form | `201` | `201` |
| no `scope`, either form | `201`, stored as sent (no `scope` key) | `201`, stored as sent: the door still stores what it was sent, so absence stays absent |
| `ManifestSchema.safeParse` with `cloud` / `system` / `project` | accepted | accepted, unchanged |

## Measured: the door needed one line, and why I made it rather than stopping

A2 assumed narrowing the declaration makes the door refuse with no runtime change. That holds for the **verdict** and fails for the **sentence**. Probe on the built `dist`, before the runtime line:

```text
cloud  wrapped false bare false
 union bare issues: [["invalid_union",[],"Invalid input"]]
 ManifestSchema re-parse: true | narrowed re-parse: manifest.scope "cloud" is not a scope a package installed through POST /api/v1/packages ma…
 wrapped re-parse: [["invalid_value",["manifest","scope"]]]
```

zod reports the failed union as one `invalid_union`, and `installBodyRefusal` locates the failure by re-parsing the form the caller wrote. For the bare form it re-parsed with `ManifestSchema`, which admits `cloud`. That re-parse passed, so the door fell back to the union's issues, and the bare-form refusal would have read `(body): Invalid input`: a `400` that does not say what to write. The door's own header says the re-read schemas are "the declarations `@objectstack/spec` publishes for this door; nothing here restates them", and `ManifestSchema` is no longer that branch. So the fix re-reads the branch the union actually carries. It adds no door-side verdict: which bodies are refused is still the declaration's decision alone. The ablation below shows the line is load-bearing. If the seat would rather hold the runtime file out, the alternative is the bare-form refusal without a prescription.

## Producers measured (A3)

`git grep` on `9f024d8a2c` for every sender of `POST /api/v1/packages` and every parser of `PackageInstallRequestSchema` / `PackageInstallBodySchema` outside `packages/spec`:

- `@objectstack/client` `packages.install(manifest, options)` forwards the caller's manifest, and sets no `scope` of its own.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` is the door itself.
- `packages/client/src/readme-package-install-example.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-install-body-contract.test.ts` are the two test parsers. Neither fixture carries a platform scope; both stay green unchanged.
- The CLI (`packages/cli/src`): no sender of this door.
- `metadata-protocol` `duplicatePackage` calls `installPackage` in-process, not over this door, and **strips** `scope` from the copy already ("the copy is scope-less"): the same rule this card declares.
- The platform's `scope: 'system'` / `'cloud'` manifests (plugin-auth, plugin-security, organizations, the service plugins, the apps) reach the registry by code boot (`registerApp` / `registry.installPackage(…, 'code')`), never through these schemas.
- **Studio (`../objectui`): NOT MEASURED.** The sibling checkout is not in this container and `packages/console/dist` is absent. Studio creates bases through this door. If it ever sent a platform scope, the new `400` names the fix.

No first-party producer sends `cloud` / `system` through these schemas, so the narrowing breaks nothing first-party.

## Fixtures triaged (A9)

None needed re-spelling. Every test that installs a `scope: 'system'` / `'cloud'` package seeds the registry directly and never passes through the door or the narrowed schemas: `packages-readonly-gate`, `packages-writable-verdict`, `packages-serializable-response`, `packages-install-overwrite-readonly` (its authored cloud-scoped row is exactly the already-locked shape, still meaningful), and `metadata-protocol`'s `get-meta-items-package-writable`. §8's existing `scope: 'tenant'` row still answers `400` naming `manifest.scope`.

## Rows that already locked themselves (A7): a documented operator delete, no code remedy

- **Measured:** `service-package` `start()` re-installs every `sys_packages` row as `authored` with its stored manifest (`packages/services/service-package/src/index.ts`, the hydration loop's `registry.installPackage(…, 'authored')`). `isWritablePackage` reads `manifest.scope` off the registry row. So a row stored with `cloud` / `system` before this PR is still read-only after it and after every restart. `DELETE`, `PATCH …/disable` and the overwrite door keep refusing it `422`; this PR changes nothing for such a row.
- **Recommended remedy: the documented operator delete**, written into the changeset: `DELETE FROM sys_packages WHERE id = 'PACKAGE_ID'` on the environment's database, then restart. No API door can do it, by ADR-0070 D2's own design: there is no `isSystem` escape hatch.
- **Why not a startup re-scope:** it is a stored-row rewrite at boot, the silent-rewrite class the card's filing and its review both advise against. It would also be a code remedy outside this card's file surface (a stop-and-report). And no evidence of a real affected row exists: the defect was found by a deleted probe, and no first-party producer sends the scope. If the seat or the maintainer wants a code remedy, it is a separate card on `service-package` hydration.
- Not measured: what happens to `sys_metadata` items such a package owned once its row is deleted.

## Tests and evidence (head `b78d15a5`)

- Spec build: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Spec vitest `--project local --maxWorkers=2`, full: 690/692 files on the first run. The 2 red were generated-ledger freshness (`dropped-refinements` totals; `export-origins` missing the two new exports), both fixed by regeneration; then `scripts/dropped-refinements.test.ts` + `scripts/export-origins.test.ts`: 51/51 passed. `src/api/package-api.test.ts` + `package-install-one-authority.test.ts`: 105/105.
- `check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- Spec typecheck and runtime typecheck: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Runtime, all 28 `src/domains/packages*.test.ts`: 28 files, 559 tests passed.
- Client `readme-package-install-example`, `client.test`, `return-type-precision`: 3 files, 220 tests passed.
- **Ablation 1 (runtime line)**, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the bare-branch re-parse was put back to `ManifestSchema`. Result: exactly the 4 BARE §9 cases red ("4 failed / 40 passed"), all WRAPPED cases green. Restore: blob equals HEAD `3168f2e89ab3`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation 2 (spec narrowing, reverse verification through `dist`)**: the enum was widened back to `cloud` / `system` / `project` with a marker value. `ablation-dist-preflight`: "marker present in 10 built files". Runtime contract: 11 failed / 33 passed (every §9 refusal, both forms, both overwrite spellings, the existing-row overwrite); spec: 2 failed / 90 passed. Restored, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight exit 0, "working tree clean against HEAD".
- `check-adr-0087-registration`: one declared-breaking changeset, `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, exit 0. `check-changeset-no-major`: "This diff introduces no `major` bump", exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-24062-authored-install-scope`: "0 of 14 path(s) hit the register … NOT governed"; 412 changed lines. No `skills/**` path moved.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 110): all run; 108 exit 0. Two exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, read as NOT MEASURED and left to CI: `check:skill-examples` (`packages/client-react/dist` not built here) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (dists outside this closure). `--ran` reconciliation: "110 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 108 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first refused on the shallow clone; after fetching its pinned fixture commit: "48 cases pass".
- `main` moved 3 commits past the base (`135e19e20`, `1fee13d4c`, `c40506aac`). None touches a path in this diff, so I did not merge them; CI judges the merge ref.

## Acceptance notes

- #24086 (`domain:engine`) is not addressed here. If it makes the protocol's `installPackage` parse what the door parses, it inherits this narrowing only by parsing `PackageInstallManifestSchema` (or the body union), not `ManifestSchema`. Noted for that card, not filed.
- The refusal sentence is pinned only on its subjects (`scope`, the value sent, `scope: 'project'`) beside `code` and `status`, never in full.
